# Old Ink Records

> A solarpunk research and record keeping institution founded August 26, 2026 by Jorden Lacy Jackson. Also known as the Solarpunk Scriptorium.

Old Ink Records believes record keeping is a sacred human act. It publishes Histories, Mysteries and Comedies (the record of our own lives) through publications, videos and a podcast.

## Pages
- [About](https://oldinkrecords.com/what-is-old-ink-records)
- [The Library](https://oldinkrecords.com/library-and-scriptorium): publications, videos and podcasts
- [The Sacred Art of Record Keeping](https://oldinkrecords.com/the-sacred-art-of-record-keeping): 36-page PDF, $14
- [Solarpunk: A History of the Movement](https://oldinkrecords.com/solarpunk-a-history): 14-page PDF, $7
- [Newsroom](https://oldinkrecords.com/newsroom)
